data.answer:
**Yes—Australian-resident patent filings are concentrated in New South Wales, Victoria and Queensland.** In 2025, these three states accounted for just over 80 per cent of resident applications and most of the national increase. NSW recorded 1,152 applications, Victoria 638 and Queensland 511, according to the 2026 Australian IP Report.[1]

However, the leader by filing volume is not necessarily the most patent-intensive jurisdiction. In 2024, NSW accounted for the largest share of resident standard patent applications, but the ACT had the most applications relative to its business population—just over two per thousand businesses.[2]
